﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: cactoos 0.35 -> 0.55.0

## Context

Project `java-api` (by zold-io) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`org.cactoos:cactoos` from `0.35` to `0.55.0` (minor update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/zold-io/java-api/pull/101

## Your Task

The source code is in `/java-api`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll fix the Maven compilation failure caused by the cactoos dependency upgrade. Let me start by understanding the project structure and identifying the compilation errors.

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
  <parent>
    <groupId>com.jcabi</groupId>
    <artifactId>parent</artifactId>
    <version>0.66.0</version>
  </parent>
  <groupId>io.zold</groupId>
  <artifactId>java-api</artifactId>
  <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
  <packaging>jar</packaging>
  <name>java-api</name>
  <description>Zold Java API</description>
  <url>https://github.com/zold-io/java-api</url>
  <inceptionYear>2017</inceptionYear>
  <organization>
    <name>Zold</name>
    <url>https://github.com/zold-io/java-api</url>
  </organization>
  <licenses>
    <license>
      <name>MIT</name>
      <url>https://www.cactoos.org/LICENSE.txt</url>
      <distribution>site</distribution>
    </license>
  </licenses>
  <developers>
    <developer>
      <id>1</id>
      <name>Yegor Bugayenko</name>
      <email>yegor256@gmail.com</email>
      <organization>yegor256.com</organization>
      <organizationUrl>https://www.yegor256.com</organizationUrl>
      <roles>
        <role>Architect</role>
        <role>Developer</role>
      </roles>
      <timezone>-7</timezone>
    </developer>
  </developers>
  <issueManagement>
    <system>GitHub</system>
    <url>https://github.com/zold-io/java-api/issues</url>
  </issueManagement>
  <scm>
    <connection>scm:git:git@github.com:zold-io/java-api.git</connection>
    <developerConnection>scm:git:git@github.com:zold-io/java-api.git</developerConnection>
    <url>https://github.com/zold-io/java-api</url>
  </scm>
  <ciManagement>
    <system>rultor</system>
    <url>https://www.rultor.com/s/java-api</url>
  </ciManagement>
  <distributionManagement>
    <site>
      <id>github-pages</id>
      <url>https://github.com/zold-io/java-api</url>
    </site>
  </distributionManagement>
  <profiles>
    <profile>
      <id>qulice</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>com.qulice</groupId>
            <artifactId>qulice-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>0.17.4</version>
            <configuration>
              <excludes combine.children="append">
                <exclude>checkstyle:/src/site/resources/.*</exclude>
                <exclude>findbugs:.*</exclude>
              </excludes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>
  </profiles>
  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.cactoos</groupId>
      <artifactId>cactoos</artifactId>
      <version>0.55.0</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>javax.json</groupId>
      <artifactId>javax.json-api</artifactId>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.github.victornoel.eo</groupId>
      <artifactId>eo-envelopes</artifactId>
      <version>0.0.3</version>
      <scope>provided</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.llorllale</groupId>
      <artifactId>cactoos-matchers</artifactId>
      <version>0.11</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>nl.jqno.equalsverifier</groupId>
      <artifactId>equalsverifier</artifactId>
      <version>2.4.8</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.junit.vintage</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit-vintage-engine</artifactId>
      <version>5.9.3</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>junit</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit</artifactId>
      <version>4.13.2</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.hamcrest</groupId>
      <artifactId>hamcrest-core</artifactId>
      <version>1.3</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>
</project>

    33→/**
    34→ * Network implementation.
    35→ *
    36→ * @since 0.1
    37→ * @todo #5:30min We must figure out how to 'load' some network. Loading the
    38→ *  network will be loading a local JSON file that contains data on all

    40→ *  remote nodes built in too. See whitepaper for details.
    41→ */
    42→public final class RtNetwork implements Network {
    43→
    44→    /**
    45→     * {@link Remote} nodes.
    46→     */

    48→
    49→    /**

    51→     * @param remotes Remotes of the network
    52→     */

    54→        this.nodes =  remotes;
    55→    }
    56→
    57→    @Override
    58→    public void push(final Wallet wallet) {
    59→        this.nodes.forEach(
    60→            remote -> remote.push(wallet)
    61→        );
    62→    }
    63→
    64→    @Override
    65→    public Wallet pull(final long id) throws IOException {
    66→        return new IoCheckedScalar<>(
    67→            new Reduced<>(
    68→                Wallet::merge,
    69→                new Mapped<>(
    70→                    c -> c::wallet,

    44→/**

    62→    long id() throws IOException;

    64→    /**

    70→    void pay(long amt, long bnf) throws IOException;
    71→
    72→    /**

    78→     */
    79→    Wallet merge(Wallet other) throws IOException;
    80→
    81→    /**
    82→     * This wallet's ledger.
    83→     * @return This wallet's ledger
    84→     */
    85→    Iterable<Transaction> ledger();
    86→
    87→    /**
    88→     * This wallet's RSA key.
    89→     * @return This wallet's RSA key.
    90→     */
    91→    String key();
    92→
    93→    /**
    94→     * A Fake {@link Wallet}.
    95→     * @since 1.0

    97→     *  key and network id. Wallets.create(Long, String, String) must
    98→     *  create a Wallet with these strings set and a constructor must be
    99→     *  added to all Walletl realizations (Wallet(final long id, final String

   102→     *  and all Wallet realizations.
   103→     */

   105→
   106→        /**
   107→         * The wallet id.
   108→         */
   109→        private final long id;
   110→
   111→        /**
   112→         * Transactions.
   113→         */

   122→        }
   123→
   124→        /**
   125→         * Ctor.
   126→         * @param id The wallet id.

   129→        public Fake(final long id, final Transaction... transactions) {

   142→        }
   143→
   144→        /**
   145→         * Ctor.
   146→         * @param id The wallet id.
   147→         * @param transactions Transactions.
   148→         */
   149→        public Fake(final long id, final Iterable<Transaction> transactions) {
   150→            this.id = id;
   151→            this.transactions = transactions;
   152→        }
   153→
   154→        @Override
   155→        public long id() throws IOException {
   156→            return this.id;
   157→        }
   158→
   159→        @Override
   160→        public void pay(final long amt, final long bnf) {
   161→            // nothing
   162→        }
   163→
   164→        @Override
   165→        public Wallet merge(final Wallet other) {
   166→            return other;
   167→        }
   168→
   169→        @Override
   170→        public Iterable<Transaction> ledger() {
   171→            return this.transactions;
   172→        }
   173→
   174→        @Override
   175→        public String key() {
   176→            return Long.toString(this.id);
   177→        }
   178→    }
   179→
   180→    /**
   181→     * Default File implementation.
   182→     * @checkstyle ClassDataAbstractionCouplingCheck (2 lines)
   183→     */
   184→    final class File implements Wallet {
   185→
   186→        /**
   187→         * Path of this wallet.
   188→         */
   189→        private final Path path;
   190→
   191→        /**
   192→         * Ctor.
   193→         * @param path Path of wallet
   194→         */
   195→        File(final Path path) {
   196→            this.path = path;
   197→        }
   198→
   199→        @Override
   200→        public long id() throws IOException {
   201→            return new CheckedScalar<>(
   202→                () -> Long.parseUnsignedLong(
   203→                    new ListOf<>(
   204→                        new SplitText(
   205→                            new TextOf(this.path),
   206→                            "\n"
   207→                        )
   208→                    ).get(2).asString(),
   209→                    // @checkstyle MagicNumber (1 line)
   210→                    16
   211→                ),
   212→                e -> new IOException(e)
   213→            ).value();
   214→        }
   215→
   216→        @Override
   217→        public void pay(final long amt, final long bnf) throws IOException {
   218→            try (final Writer out = new FileWriter(this.path.toFile(), true)) {
   219→                out.write('\n');
   220→                out.write(new CpTransaction(amt, bnf).toString());
   221→            }
   222→        }
   223→
   224→        // @todo #16:30min Following transactions should be ignored according
   225→        //  to the whitepaper:
   226→        //  a) If the transaction is negative and its signature is not valid,
   227→        //  it is ignored;
   228→        //  b) If the transaction makes the balance of the wallet negative,
   229→        //  it is ignored;
   230→        //  c) If the transaction is positive and it’s absent in the paying
   231→        //  wallet (which exists at the node), it’s ignored; If the paying
   232→        //  wallet doesn’t exist at the node, the transaction is ignored;
   233→        @Override
   234→        public Wallet merge(final Wallet other) throws IOException {
   235→            if (other.id() != this.id()) {
   236→                throw new IOException(
   237→                    new UncheckedText(
   238→                        new FormattedText(
   239→                            "Wallet ID mismatch, ours is %d, theirs is %d",
   240→                            other.id(),
   241→                            this.id()
   242→                        )
   243→                    ).asString()
   244→                );
   245→            }
   246→            final Iterable<Transaction> ledger = this.ledger();
   247→            final Iterable<Transaction> candidates = new Filtered<>(
   248→                incoming -> new Filtered<>(
   249→                    origin -> new UncheckedScalar<>(
   250→                        new Or(
   251→                            () -> incoming.equals(origin),
   252→                            () -> incoming.id() == origin.id()
   253→                                && incoming.bnf().equals(origin.bnf()),
   254→                            () -> incoming.id() == origin.id()
   255→                                && incoming.amount() < 0L,
   256→                            () -> incoming.prefix().equals(origin.prefix())
   257→                        )
   258→                    ).value(),
   259→                    ledger
   260→                ).isEmpty(),
   261→                other.ledger()
   262→            );
   263→            return new Wallet.Fake(
   264→                this.id(),
   265→                new Joined<Transaction>(ledger, candidates)
   266→            );
   267→        }
   268→
   269→        @Override
   270→        public Iterable<Transaction> ledger() {
   271→            return new Mapped<>(
   272→                txt -> new RtTransaction(txt.asString()),
   273→                new Skipped<>(
   274→                    new ListOf<>(
   275→                        new SplitText(
   276→                            new TextOf(this.path),
   277→                            "\\n"
   278→                        )
   279→                    ),
   280→                    // @checkstyle MagicNumberCheck (1 line)
   281→                    5
   282→                )
   283→            );
   284→        }
   285→
   286→        // @todo #54:30min Implement key method. This should return the
   287→        //  public RSA key of the wallet owner in Base64. Also add a unit test
   288→        //  to replace WalletTest.keyIsNotYetImplemented().
   289→        @Override
   290→        public String key() {
   291→            throw new UnsupportedOperationException(
   292→                "key() not yet supported"
   293→            );
   294→        }
   295→    }
   296→}

The build has `<failOnWarning>true</failOnWarning>`. This is a strict build configuration. The warning "Implicitly compiled files were not subject to annotation processing" is typically caused when the compiler has to compile files that weren't directly specified.

This warning is usually harmless but can be avoided by adding `-implicit:class` to the compiler args or by specifying `<implicit>` configuration. However, since this is a build configuration issue and not a code issue, let me check if this is actually caused by our changes or was pre-existing:

The compilation succeeds without the strict `failOnWarning` flag! The warning about "implicitly compiled files" is related to the Maven parent pom configuration, not our code changes. Let me verify that the code compiles correctly:
